title: Console: Governed rollout orchestration, cost storytelling & micro-training plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Coordinate cross-team go-to-market for a Console release that introduces governed rollouts, per-route cost storytelling, and a set of 20-minute micro-training sessions for PM/SE/CS. Deliverables: release notes, staged rollout runbook, training recordings, and customer-facing cost examples.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes approved by Docs and Legal
Rollout runbook validated in staging rehearsals
Three micro-training decks recorded and published
Feature flag gating and telemetry events verified in staging
Customer-facing cost examples added to knowledge base
tasks: Draft release notes and circulate to Docs/Legal
Author rollout orchestration runbook with explicit rollback criteria
Build 3 x 20-min micro-training decks and record sessions
Coordinate with Eng on feature flag gating and telemetry
Create CS FAQ and canned responses for support
rollout_phases: Phase 0: Internal dogfood + monitoring hooks (2 days)
Phase 1: Early access for 10 integration partners (1 week)
Phase 2: Gradual ramp to 25% accounts with telemetry review (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Full availability and marketing announcement
communication_plan: Internal: announcement + runbook + Slack channel for live ops
Enablement: three 20-min micro-training sessions recorded and scheduled
External: customer newsletter with cost-first narrative and worked examples
Docs: annotated release notes + KB article + cost calculator link
risk_and_mitigation: Telemetry gaps could obscure regressions — mitigation: enable detailed traces and alert thresholds before Phase 1
Customer confusion about unit economics — mitigation: include 3 worked examples and a simple cost calculator in KB
Rollout instability with autoscaling — mitigation: limit early access to low-traffic accounts and pre-run load tests
